note: BOOK BACK MATTER, NOT CHAPTER 14 CONTENT. This is printed page 524, the FIFTH AND LAST page of the book's INDEX (the chapter-14 PDF runs on past the chapter's real end into the book's back matter: answers, bibliography, index). An index is publishing furniture and MUST NOT be used as chapter-14 passage text, and no index line may be treated as chapter prose. It is transcribed only because the A2 schema rejects a zero-block page and so the page-coverage check can see the page was deliberately accounted for rather than dropped. previous_page_last_block was null, so continuation was judged from the p055 output I wrote immediately before this one, whose index run ended at 'Thermionic emission 388'; this page resumes the same alphabetical list at 'Thermonuclear fusion', and for an alphabetical index a column running past the page foot counts as a continuation, so first_block_continues_from_previous is true. Two columns, left first, matching the text layer's order: block n=1 is the left column (Thermonuclear fusion 456 ... Valence band 469) and block n=2 the right column (Velocity selector 140 ... breakdown 485). The index finishes here at the last entry 'Zener / breakdown 485' and only the bottom two-thirds of the page is blank below it, so last_block_continues_on_next is false. The chapter header banner 'Physics', the page number 524 and the reprint year 2022-23 are furniture and are listed as removed; note that the text layer emits '524' twice, once as a stray at the very top of the layer and once in list order after 'Valence band 469' (the footer's position in the layer) — both occurrences are the same page number and are covered by the single '524' entry in running_header_footer_removed. Copied exactly as the text layer spells it, including 'Voltage Regulator' and 'Uncertainty Principle' with their printed capitals. No equations, tables or figures on this page.
